title: One-Handed
wikitext:
'''One Handed''' is a keyword which applies to the use of weapons which can take up the [[Main Hand]] or the [[Off Hand]] equipment slots. 

[[Item class]]es which count as One Handed:

* [[Claws]]
* [[Daggers]]
* [[One Hand Axes]]
* [[One Hand Maces]]
* [[Sceptres]]
* [[One Hand Swords]]
* [[Thrusting One Hand Swords]]
* [[Wands]]

In almost all cases, modifiers for One Handed apply only to melee, for example using the phrase "One Handed Melee Weapons" on a passive skill. See [[One-handed melee weapon]].
